{{Quote|Someone once told me that Ginx become more aggressive the larger they grow in size. I thought that was rubbish-until now.|Doctor [[Armaxa]]|<ref name="bigGinx">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Ginx of an Unusual Size|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Barbed Ginx''' was the most common species of [[Ginx]]. It was a relatively harmless, curious [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] that frequented [[Makeb]]'s marshes.<ref name="codex" /> They were first discovered by scientist [[Dep Aila]] on Makeb when he found the creatures surrounding his speeder having pulled the exterior casing off in search of food. The "barbed" in their name refers to the barbed "thumb" which allows them to peel bark from trees or fallen logs when foraging for insects.

Barbed Ginx could grew up to the size twice as high as an average [[Human/Legends|human]]; becoming more aggressive as they grew.<ref name="bigGinx" /> 

==History==
Barbed Ginx have a genetic relation to the more aggressive [[Vrake (species)|Vrakes]].<ref name="codex" /> Two main color variants existed: blue with yellow back, belly and digits,<ref name="blue ginx" /> and black with red back.<ref name="black ginx" /> A unique green with black pattern coloring existed, a Barbed ginx named [[Bilinguis]] had it.<ref name="green ginx" /> Outside Makeb, the species was prominent on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]].<ref name="yavin">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]]}}</ref> Some of them were also present on the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] world of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]].<ref name="copero">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>
